# File Preview Syntax Highlighting - Requirements Document Index

## Document Overview

This directory contains the complete requirements document suite for the "File Preview Syntax Highlighting" feature.

**Feature Summary**: Add syntax highlighting support to the skill package file preview feature, improving code readability.

**Clarity Score**: 95/100

## Business Rules Quick Reference

| Rule ID | Description | Priority |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-001 | File size > 500KB → plain text (no highlighting) | Must |
| BR-002 | File size > 1MB → download only | Must |
| BR-003 | Language unrecognized → plain text (no error) | Must |
| BR-004 | Rendering failure → fall back to plain text | Must |
| BR-005 | Insufficient memory → fall back to plain text | Should |
| BR-006 | Theme follows system | Must |
| BR-007 | Style consistent with Markdown | Must |
| BR-008 | Copy function retained | Must |

---

## Risk Quick Reference

| Risk ID | Description | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |
|---------|------|------|------|---------|
| R-001 | Large file lag | Medium | High | 500KB threshold |
| R-005 | Rendering failure crash | Low | High | Error Boundary |
| R-007 | Backend performance degradation | Medium | Medium | Future caching + rate limiting |
| R-008 | XSS security risk | Low | High | Ensure output is escaped |

## Implementation Roadmap

### Phase 1: Preparation (0.5 days)
- Research highlight.js on-demand import approach
- Verify style reusability
- Design CodeRenderer component API

### Phase 2: Core Development (1.5 days)
- Create CodeRenderer component
- Extend file-type-utils.ts
- Modify file-preview-dialog.tsx
- Theme adaptation

### Phase 3: Integration and Testing (1 day)
- Unit tests (16 test methods)
- Integration tests (11 test methods)
- Performance tests (4 scenarios)
- Browser compatibility tests

### Phase 4: Deployment and Monitoring (0.5 days)
- Code review (security, performance)
- Deploy to production
- Configure monitoring metrics
- Update documentation

## Document Usage Guide

### Development Phase
1. **Before starting development**: Read the PRD and constraints specification to understand feature boundaries and business rules
2. **While writing code**: Reference the impact analysis to understand which files need to be modified
3. **While writing tests**: Reference the acceptance cases and test plan to ensure all scenarios are covered
4. **During code review**: Check that all business rules (BR-XXX) are satisfied

### Testing Phase
1. **Unit tests**: Follow the test plan, ensure coverage > 80%
2. **Integration tests**: Verify all acceptance cases (AC-XXX)
3. **Performance tests**: Ensure performance constraints are met (500KB < 500ms)
4. **Security tests**: Verify XSS protection (AC-S-XXX)

### Deployment Phase
1. **Before deployment**: Verify the rollback plan is ready
2. **After deployment**: Monitor error rate and performance metrics
3. **Troubleshooting**: Reference the risk assessment (R-XXX) to locate issues
